Author: Vipin Chandra Dixit

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 92
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 7596 of 2023
Applicant :- Satpal @ Sattan

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Brij Lal Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Aditya Kumar Rai,Dhirendra Kumar Verma Hon'ble Vipin Chandra Dixit,J.
Heard Sri Brij Lal Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case being father-in-law of the deceased.

It is stated in para 11 of the affidavit filed along with bail application that the applicant is living separately with his son and daughter-in-law and has no concern with the family affairs of his son.
In the first information report the allegations are general in nature and the entire family of husband was roped in this case.

The mother-in-law of the deceased namely Bhoora Devi having identical role has already been released on bail by the coordinate Bench of this Court, vide order dated 13.12.2022, passed in Criminal Misc.
Bail Application No. 56829 of 2022.

Bail Application No. 56829 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Copy of the bail order has been annexed as Annexure No. 7 to the affidavit filed along with bail application.

The role assigned to the applicant is similar and identical to the role assigned to the aforesaid co-accused who has already been released on bail, as such, the present applicant is also entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity.

The applicant has no previous criminal history and there is no possibility of fleeing away from the Satpal @ Sattan vs State Of U.P. on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131273790/
1 judicial process or tampering with the witnesses and in case, the applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant shall not misuse the liberty of bail.

sentences.text: The applicant is in jail since 08.01.2023.
Learned A.G.A. for the State vehemently opposed the prayer of bail.
However, he does not dispute the aforesaid facts.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, from perusal of the record and considering the complicity of accused, severity of punishment as well as totality of facts and circumstances, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, I find it a fit case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Satpal @ Sattan be released on bail in Case Crime No. 128 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 D.P. Act, registered at Police Station Jarcha, District Gautam Buddh Nagar, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:
(i) The applicant will not tamper with prosecution evidence and will not harm or harass the victim / complainant in any manner whatsoever.
(ii) The applicant will abide by the orders of the court, will attend the court on every date and will not delay the disposal of trial in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) The applicant will not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iv) The applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail in any manner whatsoever.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.
